{{Unknown name}} [[File:Robert grandfather.png|thumb|250px|Robert's grandfather]] '''Robert's grandfather''' (Japanese: '''ロバートの祖父''' ''Robert's grandfather'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared during {{OBP|Robert|BW054}}'s flashbacks in ''[[BW054|The Four Seasons of Sawsbuck!]]''. He was a Pokémon [[Photography|photographer]] who traveled around the {{pkmn|world}}. His grandson Robert admired his grandfather's works, particularly a photo of all four {{fd|Sawsbuck|seasonal forms}} of {{p|Sawsbuck}} in one place. After showing {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} his grandfather's album, they agreed to help Robert replicate the rare snapshot. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=三宅健太 ''[[Kenta Miyake]]'' |cs=Tomáš Juřička |da=Michael Hasselflug |en=[[Bill Rogers]] |fi=Arto Nieminen |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |no=Simen Sand |pl=Mariusz Krzemiński |es_la=Alejandro Villeli |es_eu=Eduardo del Hoyo }}
